exclude.justification: The implementation package is not meant to be used directly, and as such does not need to maintain any backwards compatibility guarantees.
Annotation processor internals are not part of the public API surface.
Test support classes are not part of the public API surface.
Spring events are not part of the public API surface and should be excluded.
Actuator classes are not part of the public API surface and should be excluded.
JobHandling classes are not part of the public API surface and should be excluded.
Annotation value classes are not part of the public API surface and should be excluded.

differences.justification: Unification onto the single multi-client config path (#57344): CamundaAutoConfiguration is now the unified auto-configuration; the single-client lifecycle producer bean is replaced by the multi-client MultiCamundaLifecycleEventProducer. Internal auto-configuration wiring; compatibility impact accepted for this release.
